title: Thermodynamic Fluid–Solid Phase Transitions
exact_target: Prove a genuine equilibrium fluid-to-solid phase transition, with hard spheres as a central example.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath, record 30003987 (OWR-16632-002). Catalogue curation under CC BY 4.0; definitions and English exposition added locally.

Emergence of Structures in Particle Systems: Mechanics, Analysis and Computation (2018), Oberwolfach Reports, DOI 10.4171/owr/2018/49, pp. 2915--2967. Primary report accessed 2026-10-11; relevant PDF pages 37.
Hard-Sphere Crystallization Review (catalogue-listed context; not independently consulted in this preparation).

status_qualification: The dimension, ensemble and phase criterion are not fixed by the extracted question. Numerical crystallization or a finite-system packing optimum does not by itself prove the requested thermodynamic transition.
